name: ouroboros-ui
summary: Token-first Rust/egui port of the shadcn/ui design language, with 60+ components and build-enforced rules.
description: The shadcn/ui design language reimplemented natively for egui in Rust: 60+ components across atoms, cells, molecules and organisms, plus a node-editor graph layer. Governance tests run in cargo test and CI — raw colors, fonts or spacing outside the token layer fail the build, and only atoms touch the painter. Ships a component catalog, a wasm storybook and docs with per-component pages (anatomy, variants, states, API).
contains: 60+ components across atoms, cells, molecules and organisms, plus a node-editor graph layer
23 atoms including avatar, badge, button, checkbox, input, progress, slider, spinner, switch, textarea and tooltip
cells: list item, menu item, property row, responsive row, table cell, table row, toolbar button, tree node
molecules: alert, breadcrumb, card, collapsible, input group, radio group, search field, tabs
governance tests fail the build on raw colors, fonts or spacing outside the token layer
token-first theming with a zinc palette, 4px scale and dark and light modes
Rust 1.92 pinned, egui 0.34.1, builder API, wasm storybook
